findings: Candidate commit bc8b35f4f02af6e76819736b60872b03d72dce93 (tree 678b59a139e7130ad4d668e3998a0909fb2b8bdf) over base dac00001652b5c4a6297de1d3a8747f743432dfa (tree e9d7103deb0a693b9d6c4859f8a0b1d31748fe46) adds only the 9 scoped paths: crates/mori-core/tests/program_ir_contract.rs (SHA-256 5b359d34bb404c2b35a6bdd53374aaf4db65910b104f17cf9a13290dd390a2db, rustfmt-clean) and crates/fixtures/program-ir-contract/{DERIVATION.md,INVENTORY.json,counter.mori,counter.program.expected.json,empty-frame.mori,empty-frame.program.expected.json,FREEZE.sha256,README.md}, with zero production or dependency changes.

All 6 frozen oracle members and FREEZE.sha256 (SHA-256 c1b5027d0cab397134337d4346e2c956fffde532d4a9e56843b725df212cba99) under candidate/crates/fixtures/program-ir-contract/ match independent-oracles/ byte-for-byte, preserving the prior 7a314c14... .mori sources and post-adoption DTO/grammar/representation-premise provenance without parser/runtime output generation.

Both test functions in program_ir_contract.rs invoke public mori_core::parse on the exact fixture strings, serialize the entire returned Program via serde_json::to_value(&program), decode the frozen expected JSON file into serde_json::Value, and assert full equality across all seven Program fields (language, semantics, name, states, assets, expressions, actions) without projection, filtering, normalization, or reordering.

Static trace of mori_core::parse, ir.rs, and runtime::validate confirms exact correspondence: Counter produces 1 state (count=UInt 0 stored in StateDecl.initial), 0 assets, 11 expression nodes in lexical/postorder (0:Name count, 1:Name amount, 2:Add(0,1), 3:Name total, 4:Literal UInt 100, 5:Le(3,4), 6:Name total, 7:Name count, 8:Name total, 9:Eq(7,8), 10:Name count), and 1 action run(amount:UInt) with 5 statement roots (2,5,6,9,10); PreservedIdleFrame produces 2 states (count=UInt 5, ready=Bool true), 1 asset CASH (local, normal-report-empty-oracle, CASH, scale 2), 1 global expression node at ExprId 0 (Literal UInt 0), and 2 actions in source order (idle empty, plus uninvoked declare retaining its Liability statement referencing reserve, CASH, treasury, beneficiary, amount ExprId 0).

PROPOSAL.json specifies a single new bounded command (attemptLimit=1, newAttemptSequence=1) running /usr/bin/timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 60s cargo test --manifest-path .../Cargo.toml --frozen -j1 -p mori-core --no-default-features --test program_ir_contract -- --test-threads=1 with strict 13-env whitelist (no HOME), owned cold target/cargo-home/cwd/tmp under /tmp/doctorwatson-full-ir-check-, 4 pre-spawn SHA-256 tool pins, 14-path ancestor Cargo config absence check, and immediate cleanup, excluding the compatibility SDK (midnight-compat-tests is non-default), CLI, report tests, and native/ledger/proof/network paths.
limitations: Read-only source and proposal review only; no commands, Cargo, parser, runtime, or tests were executed during this review, so actual parser calls remain UNRUN pending the approved single command execution and subsequent result audit.

The two finite positive normal Program IR comparisons test only Counter and PreservedIdleFrame under mori_core::parse and do not establish general frontend/compiler/backend/native/SDK correspondence, simulation report byte conformance, or closure of any parent roadmap exit.

Oracle expectations are post-adoption derivations from public DTOs, grammar docs, and explicit source-order/fresh-node/postorder representation premises rather than blinded pre-implementation oracles.
Security review in this cycle uses the designated Gemini authorized outage fallback after the recorded Opus 4.8 rate failure at 06:54:51 UTC without recovery, rather than Opus.
